procedure.translation_comparison: French rapid/unplanned/no-rereading and conscious-contribution instructions corroborate essential Seaver/Lane1969 transcription facts. Not a full textual collation or manuscript authentication. French excerpt omits the concentration-setting clause and later continuation/arbitrary-letter restart passage; these are not frozen French-subset rules.
procedure.historical_restart: Seaver/Lane online transcription describes an arbitrary-letter restart; only a qualified external reference, not required or verified against French original in this profile.
editorial: All session states/events, optional timestamps/constraints, interruption/restart controls, draft assembly, revisions, metrics and review questions are application conventions.
Stop, pause or omit participation freely; no fixed historical duration, mental-state compliance score or mandatory restart technique.
Revision is a separately labeled creative extension; does not retroactively change the first draft or claim fidelity to a historical first-and-last-draft ideal.
limits: No source-specific spiritualist, ideomotor or stream-of-consciousness procedure implemented.
Moses and Breton/Soupault exemplar remain separate; no generated writing, extraordinary authorship, diagnosis, hidden memories or predictions.

event.comment: Editorial restart; no arbitrary letter required.

first_draft.concatenation: Exact ordered segment text concatenation with empty separator; no normalization

metric_conventions.characters: Python Unicode code points; no normalization or grapheme counting
metric_conventions.words: Maximal nonempty runs separated by Python str.isspace Unicode whitespace; punctuation/emoji remain in tokens
metric_conventions.lines: Empty text0; otherwise1 plus CRLF/CR/LF delimiters; CRLF is one delimiter, final empty line counted
metric_conventions.duration: Begin-to-stop declared compatible datetime endpoints only; includes pauses; no inferred active typing time
metric_conventions.segment_intervals: Sum only when every segment declares an integer interval; not inferred or equated to wall duration

evidence_layers.direct: Seven attributed Breton French-excerpt procedure facts only
evidence_layers.user_authored: Raw events, segments, revisions, comments, constraints and associations
evidence_layers.editorial: State machine, controls, hashes, metrics, review and revision model; constraints may differ from historical procedure
evidence_layers.unsupported: Spirit contact, trance/unconscious-origin/authorship verification, diagnosis, hidden memories, future prediction

editorial_questions: Which first-draft passages do you choose to retain?

limitations: No source-specific spiritualist, ideomotor or stream-of-consciousness procedure implemented.
Moses and Breton/Soupault exemplar remain separate; no generated writing, extraordinary authorship, diagnosis, hidden memories or predictions.
Events and authorship are declarations, not mental-state or historical-compliance verification.
Append-only validation applies within each supplied session log; no persistent database, authentication or cross-file tamper protection. Preserve replay files to retain versions.
